fixed.summary: A wrapping row sized to its content (`w-fit`, or any automatic width) keeps its items on one line when they fit: it used to wrap its last item by a rounding error of the row's own width and keep a one-line height, so that item showed below the row (strategy/resources' "47 / 50 Near cap"). An item now wraps only past 0.01 px over the line, the slack a text keeps at its own width.
